description: This is a shell test script for testing the behavior of the git-http-backend handling of CONTENT_LENGTH and related HTTP environment variables. It contains test setup, condition checks, and multiple test cases that set up specific HTTP request environments, invoke the backend, and verify responses.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response status and error messages to determine if the backend response is as expected.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables and invokes the git-http-backend with a specified request body and handler type.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a size that overflows ssize_t, depending on the build option for size_t.
